_comment: These are NOT real findings from a real system. Several are deliberately
imperfect so the tool's own error handling is demonstrable:
- FINDING-DUP-A / FINDING-DUP-B are the same defect from two tools (dedup).
- 'ERROR' and 7.8 exercise severity-alias and numeric-score mapping.
- the last record has an unrecognised severity, which must produce a
normalization warning rather than a silent downgrade.
Real findings from this project's own review live in

findings.title: IAM policy grants service-level wildcard action
findings.description: The execution role policy allows dynamodb:* rather than the three actions the application calls.
findings.remediation: Replace dynamodb:* with GetItem, PutItem and Query, and add an explicit Deny for Scan and DeleteTable.

findings.title: IAM policy grants service-level wildcard action
findings.description: IAM002: dynamodb:* implies dynamodb:Scan and dynamodb:DeleteTable, neither of which the application uses.
findings.remediation: Enumerate the three actions in use.

findings.title: Identity accepted from client-controlled request headers
findings.description: Identity extraction falls back to X-User-Id and X-Org-Id headers when the API Gateway authorizer context is absent, so any caller can assert any identity in any tenant.
findings.remediation: Read identity only from requestContext.authorizer.jwt.claims. Remove the header fallback entirely.

findings.title: Update path performs no object-level authorization check
findings.description: The authorization helper was defined but never invoked on the update path, so any member could modify any ticket in their organization.
findings.remediation: Call authorize_update_ticket and enforce the Decision before applying changes.

findings.title: Development server binds to all network interfaces
findings.description: B104: uvicorn.run(host='0.0.0.0') makes a local development server reachable from the network.
findings.remediation: Default to 127.0.0.1 and require an explicit environment variable to widen the bind address.

findings.title: SYNTHETIC-ADVISORY-0001 affects example-synthetic-lib 1.2.3
findings.description: Synthetic advisory used to exercise numeric severity mapping. Not a real CVE and not a real package.

findings.title: Log group has no retention policy
findings.description: A log group with no retention keeps data forever, which is both an unbounded cost and an unbounded retention obligation for logs containing tenant identifiers.

findings.title: Table encrypted with an AWS-owned key rather than a customer-managed key
findings.description: Encryption at rest is active, but with an AWS-owned key there is no auditable key policy and no independent rotation or revocation.
findings.remediation: Create a customer-managed KMS key and set kms_key_arn on the server_side_encryption block.

findings.title: HTTP API cannot have a WAF attached
findings.description: API Gateway HTTP APIs do not support AWS WAF. Rate limiting is handled by stage throttling instead. Accepted as a residual risk of choosing HTTP API over REST API.
findings.remediation: If WAF becomes a requirement, either migrate to REST API or front the HTTP API with CloudFront plus WAF.

findings.title: Listing used a table Scan with a post-query tenant filter
findings.description: A Scan reads every tenant's items and makes isolation dependent on a FilterExpression rather than on the key condition.
findings.remediation: Replace with a Query pinned to the tenant partition, and add GSI1 for the per-member access pattern.

findings.title: MFA is optional rather than required in the development environment
findings.description: cognito_mfa_configuration is OPTIONAL in dev so the scripted demo can sign in without registering a TOTP factor. Production tfvars sets ON.
findings.remediation: Set cognito_mfa_configuration = "ON". Already set in the production tfvars.

findings.title: Unrecognised severity label, used to exercise normalization warnings
findings.description: This record deliberately uses an unmapped severity label and a synonym category so the normalization warnings in the report can be demonstrated.
findings.remediation: None required; this record exists to test input handling.
